title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A leading star that skipped the root
summary: The setting that keeps Gradle build logic out of the unreferenced symbol report never worked, because a leading double star was read as one directory or more instead of zero or more.

highlights.title: buildSrc Is Excluded Again
highlights.description: Gradle puts buildSrc at the root of the project, and the shipped default pattern demanded a directory before it. A convention plugin is named by its file, so every declaration inside looked unreferenced.

highlights.title: Your Own Ignore Patterns
highlights.description: A pattern starting with a double star now covers the root as well, the way the editor's own globs and gitignore read it.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No verdict changes on the real project, the report stays at 99 findings. The file under buildSrc produced none today, which is luck rather than correctness.
Three sources carried a raw NUL byte where an escape was meant, and one of them was read as binary by git, so its deliveries showed no diff at all. A new guard fails the build if one comes back.
